statement: I'm a full-stack and AI/ML engineer from Ahmedabad, India. For close to five years I've helped startups and teams ship products end to end: Python backends that scale, fast Next.js interfaces, and AI that's actually useful, from RAG assistants to voice agents that pick up the phone.
paragraphs: I've built for clients in India, the UK and the US, across legal tech, e-commerce, SaaS tools, mentorship platforms and data science. I like owning the whole problem, from the first conversation and the data model to the deploy and what happens after it.
Clients tend to mention the same things: clear communication, clean code and on-time delivery. That's the bar I hold myself to on every project.
